summary: Confirmed $15/night (RV nonelectric, every rate season through 2028), no electric at any site, reservable on recreation.gov (inherited, now on the entry). Added 14-night max in 30 days, 45 sites (16 RV, 29 tent-only), flush toilets and drinking water. Not stated: site lengths, season dates (the calendar accrual shows sites open late June through September 2026 only), dump station (inclusion_evidence mentions one; the current page does not). rec.gov's 'militaryDiscount' rule flag has no prose; not recorded.
